title: Normalized scalar chain map on one finite tensor level
statement: Let l be prime, let E and L be finite extensions of Q_l, and let iota:E -> L be a Q_l-algebra embedding. For F=E,L fix its valuation ring and uniformizer. On the small pro-etale site of a scheme W, put R_F,W=lim_m (O_F/pi_F^(m+1))_W, A_F,W=(O_F/pi_F^(n+1))_W, p_F:R_F,W -> A_F,W the quotient projection, j_W:R_E,W -> R_L,W the completed scalar map, and k_W:A_E,W -> A_L,W the quotient scalar map. Thus p_E;k_W=j_W;p_L. Write S_W(M)=R_L,W tensor_(R_E,W) M and T_F,W(M)=A_F,W tensor_(R_F,W) M, with sheafified ordinary tensor, their canonical unit sections denoted 1 tensor x. Restriction of scalars is understood along the displayed ring maps. All complexes below are arbitrary unbounded cochain complexes with termwise ordinary scalar extension and reduction. Write D_F,n(P,Q)=Res_pF Tot(T_F(P) tensor_(A_F,W) T_F(Q)), with direct-sum totalization and its signed differential. For each pair P,Q there exists a chain map alpha:S_W(D_E,n(P,Q)) -> D_L,n(S_W(P),S_W(Q)). This statement requires only this chain map and its normalization, without naturality in P,Q. For every pair P,Q of complexes, degrees p,q, object U and sections x in P^p(U), y in Q^q(U), its degree p+q component sends 1 tensor ((1 tensor x) tensor (1 tensor y)) in the (p,q) total-tensor summand to (1 tensor (1 tensor x)) tensor (1 tensor (1 tensor y)) in the corresponding target summand. All tensor sections are the canonical sheafification-unit sections. This is existence with this normalization only, requiring no flatness or boundedness hypothesis. These coefficient, module and tensor constructions use [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension], [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower], [lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined], [def-pur-integral-finite-tensor-tower], [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], [def-pur-change-of-rings-complex], [def-sfb-scalar-extension-pure-tensor-section], [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars].

proof.text: Apply the existing signed total tensor chain-map construction TensorChainProof.map to b_P and b_Q degreewise. The coefficient square allows restriction from finite coefficients to the completed source coefficients. This gives an adjunct from the source finite tensor complex to the restriction of the target scalar tensor complex.

Transpose the adjunct through the scalar extension/restriction adjunction lifted to complexes. Its unit formula, TensorChainProof.pure on the (p,q) summand of the signed total tensor, and the two unit formulas for b give precisely the stated normalization. All totalization signs and compatibility with differentials are supplied by the existing total-tensor chain map, rather than a new degreewise assertion.
